script.title: MY FIRST VOTE
script.scene_zh: 社區登記桌 · 選民登記
script.story_hook: A brand-new adult meets a folding-table volunteer.
script.intro_zh: 剛滿十八歲的她，遇上社區登記桌前的志工。
script.welcome_en: Hi everyone, great to see you! Today we're registering to vote.
script.welcome_zh: 大家好，很高興見到你們！今天我們要來練習選民登記的英文。
script.outro: Voting is a big deal! Keep listening and see you next time.
script.outro_zh: 投票是很了不起的事！繼續多聽，我們下次再見。
script.practice_intro_en: Repeat each line after me, nice and slow.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在跟著我一句一句重複，慢慢地來。
script.char_a_description: a bright teenager with a high honey-blonde ponytail and freckled cheeks, wearing a sunshine-yellow hoodie and a navy satchel across her shoulder, clicking a pen eagerly
script.char_b_description: a relaxed man in his mid twenties with shoulder-length locs tied back, wearing round amber glasses and a community-college tee, tapping a clipboard against his knee
script.youtube_title: 【🗳️人生第一次投票】「能跳過政黨嗎」怎麼說？18句選民登記對話🎧聽完就敢問💡｜🌱A2初級｜Voter Registration English
script.youtube_title_en: "First Vote of Your Life" — Registering to Vote at a Community Table
script.youtube_description:
年滿十八，想登記投票卻聽不懂志工在問什麼？身分證字號、無黨籍、截止日、投票所位置——跟著 Zoe 在社區登記桌前一次搞懂！整段 18 句美式日常英語，附上繁體中文翻譯與 IPA 標音，後半段逐句跟讀，聽一遍就敢大聲問。
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
訂閱我們的頻道，每天一集，讓英語變成你的直覺！
script.youtube_description_en:
Turned eighteen and want to register, but nervous about the questions? Follow Zoe at a community registration table as she gives her ID number, chooses no party, beats the deadline, and learns where her polling place is — 18 lines of everyday American English with IPA, plus a repeat-after-me section.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new listening episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🗳️選民登記英文｜報出住址・選擇黨籍・確認截止日｜聽完就會登記｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
剛滿十八歲，第一次登記投票，聽得懂嗎？
身分證字號、政黨、截止日，該怎麼回答？

這一集帶大家走進社區活動中心的登記桌，跟著 Zoe 從報出電話號碼、提供身分證與住址、挑選「無黨籍」，一路問到截止日與投票所位置，全程都是自然的美式英語。

你會聽到：
🪪 登記與資料：例如「Do I need my ID number for that?」。
🤝 黨籍的選擇：例如「Of course, none is a totally normal choice.」。
📅 截止日與地點：例如「We'll mail a card showing your polling place.」。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先完整聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

投下第一票之前，先把這十八句聽熟吧！
script.thumbnail_action: signing a registration form with a bright pen

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I turned eighteen — can I vote now?
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪ tɜrnt eɪˈtin kæn aɪ voʊt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我剛滿十八歲，現在可以投票了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You sure can! Registering takes about five minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ʃʊr kæn ˈrɛdʒɪstərɪŋ teɪks əˈbaʊt faɪv ˈmɪnəts/
dialogue.zh: 當然可以！登記大約只要五分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice. Do I need my ID number for that?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs du aɪ nid maɪ aɪˈdi ˈnʌmbər fɔr ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 好。請問需要身分證字號嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, plus the last four of your social.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs plʌs ðə læst fɔr ɑv jɔr ˈsoʊʃəl/
dialogue.zh: 要的，還有社保號的最後四碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got both right here on my phone, phew.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt boʊθ raɪt hɪr ɑn maɪ foʊn fju/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect. What's the street you live on?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt wʌts ðə strit ju lɪv ɑn/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。你住在哪一條街？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maple Street, apartment six B, is that okay?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmeɪpəl strit əˈpɑrtmənt siks bi ɪz ðæt oʊkeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 楓葉街，六號B套房，這樣可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: All good. Any political party you'd pick?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔl ɡʊd ˈɛni pəˈlɪtɪk ˈpɑrti jud pɪk/
dialogue.zh: 完全沒問題。你想選哪一黨嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, honestly, I'm not sure — can I skip it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm ˈɑnəstli aɪm nɑt ʃʊr kæn aɪ skɪp ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 呃，老實說我不確定，能先跳過嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, none is a totally normal choice.
dialogue.phonetic: /əv kɔrs nʌn ɪz ə ˈtoʊtəli ˈnɔrməl tʃɔɪs/
dialogue.zh: 當然，「無黨籍」也是非常正常的選擇。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll pick none then. When's the deadline?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl pɪk nʌn ðɛn wɛnz ðə ˈdɛəlaɪn/
dialogue.zh: 那我就選無黨籍。登記截止日是什麼時候？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: October ninth — that's this Friday, heads up!
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑkˈtoʊbər naɪnθ ðæts ðɪs ˈfraɪdeɪ hɛdz ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 十月九號——就是這週五，注意喔！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh wow, soon! Will I make it in time here?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ waʊ sun wɪl aɪ meɪk ɪt ɪn taɪm hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 哇，好快！來得及在這裡登記嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, you're at the last table, lucky you.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs jʊr ət ðə læst ˈteɪbəl ˈlʌki ju/
dialogue.zh: 來得及，你剛好坐到最後一桌，真幸運。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Phew! So where do I actually vote then?
dialogue.phonetic: /fju soʊ wɛr du aɪ ˈæktʃuəli voʊt ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 呼！那到時候我到底要去哪裡投票？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We'll mail a card showing your polling place.
dialogue.phonetic: /wil meɪl ə kɑrd ˈʃoʊɪŋ jɔr ˈpoʊlɪŋ pleɪs/
dialogue.zh: 我們會寄一張明信片，告訴你投票所。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. Can I do this online next year?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt kæn aɪ du ðɪs ˈɑnˌlaɪn nɛkst jɪr/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。明年我能在網路上辦理嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yep! First vote of your life — congrats, friend!
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛp fɜrst voʊt ɑv jɔr laɪf kənˈɡræts frɛnd/
dialogue.zh: 可以！你人生第一次投票——恭喜你，朋友！
